coverage_issues: qwen model encountered an API error (HTTP 400) when reviewing .gitignore, leaving it inconclusive.
false_positives: qwen model's UNSAFE verdict on .SRCINFO: Flagged the aarch64 URL mismatch as a supply-chain integrity violation. It is merely a copy-paste packaging error pointing to the correct upstream host.
learnings: Audit models frequently confuse severe packaging bugs (e.g., wrong architecture URLs, syntax errors) with malicious injections. The assessment criteria must explicitly clarify that functional bugs or copy-paste errors in source URLs are not security violations as long as they point to the declared upstream and are checksummed.
Tooling should implement retries for transient API errors on low-risk files like .gitignore to prevent inconclusive statuses.
